name: content-engine-by-ruby
description: Brand-neutral AI content engine. Plan a 30-day calendar, draft long-form blog articles, generate LinkedIn and Facebook social posts, validate against your brand rules, and publish. EVERYTHING - colors, fonts, voice, layout (format presets), and content model - reads from config/brand.json, so the same skills fit any company: B2B SaaS, restaurant, agency, law firm. Originally built for one brand by Ruby, now a reusable framework.
